title: docs(review-triage): keep bot trigger phrases out of PATH B reasons
body:
## Background

Parent roadmap: #2166

E6's PATH B non-review-notice template is
`**Rejected** — {bot} did not review HEAD {sha} ({reason}); this is
not a completed review (source: #issuecomment-{id})`. `{reason}` is
freeform. GitHub advisory bots scan comment bodies for their own
command-trigger strings even inside Markdown code spans.

Observed independently on three `kurone-kito/dotfiles` PRs in the
2026-08-15 run (gist `52ed338da39f8cfb80b4bf8cf7c2636d`, Finding 4):
workers quoted the bot's documented review-request mention as the
honest explanation of a skip-review / low-star gate, and the bot
replied within seconds as if a manual review had been requested.
E6's "never auto-request a fresh review to upgrade a notice" rule
covers API/actions, not this prose footgun.

Do **not** paste the bot's literal review-request mention into this
issue, any comment on it, or the eventual patch. Paraphrase only.

## Proposed change

Add a content-safety note to E6 PATH B: `{reason}` must paraphrase a
bot trigger or command, never reproduce the literal string (code
spans do not suppress GitHub bot parsing). Give one canonical
paraphrase for the low-star / manual-trigger skip-review case, for
example "requires a manually triggered review for low-star
repositories".

Do not weaken the fail-closed honesty rule or the never-auto-request
rule.

## Acceptance criteria

- `idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-review-triage.instructions.md`
  E6 PATH B states that `{reason}` must not reproduce a bot's
  literal command or trigger string, and why (code spans do not
  suppress parsing).
- The same section includes an acceptable paraphrase for the
  low-star manual-trigger skip-review case.
- The patched instruction text itself contains no bot review-request
  mention that would fire if posted on GitHub.
- `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --apply` is clean for the edited pair.
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` and `pnpm run lint:minimum`
  pass.

## Candidate files

- `idd-template/.github/instructions/idd-review-triage.instructions.md`
- generated `.github/instructions/idd-review-triage.instructions.md`

Refs gist Finding 4
